steps.title: Discovery Call

sections.heading: Why one engineer?

sections.heading: The AI agent advantage

sections.heading: What this means for you
sections.body: You get an AI engineer who actually understands your business, backed by a team that never drops the ball. Faster delivery, lower cost, higher quality — that's the math.
